title: Faster zlib/DEFLATE decompression on the Apple M1 (and x86)
relevance: Describes the overlap technique: performing refill and table lookup before chunkcopy, yielding ~6% speedup by hiding copy branch-mispredict latency.

title: A whirlwind introduction to dataflow graphs
relevance: Framework for analyzing instruction dependencies and identifying overlap opportunities. Essential for understanding which operations can execute in parallel on OoO cores.

title: A 1.4GHz 20.5Gbps GZIP decompression accelerator featuring dual-path out-of-order speculative Huffman decoder
relevance: Hardware GZIP decompressor with out-of-order speculative Huffman decoder. Demonstrates 69% throughput increase through dual-path speculative decode that overlaps with LZ77 processing.
